end.summary:
Practised visualising square and triangular-number sequences with dot pictures.
Used rows and columns to explain sequence growth and shared corner dots.
Explained why an L-shape has 2n−1 dots using a 5-by-5 example.
The final teach-back was not passed; drawing square and triangular dot pictures was not completed unaided.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised building dot pictures and explaining growth by counting rows, columns, and a shared corner only once. They initially mixed up the L-shape count and the corner adjustment, then corrected the double-counting explanation later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw 3-by-3, 4-by-4, and 5-by-5 dot squares, then mark the added row and column and count the shared corner.
